body: At Winteriors Decor, we see office interior design as a tool for business growth. Your office is more than a workplace. It reflects your company's identity and shapes how your people feel and perform every day. That is why clients searching for the best interior design in Dubai and the best interior design in Abu Dhabi trust our team to turn commercial spaces into offices that attract talent, keep it, and strengthen the brand.

We work on a design and build basis: one team plans the space, designs it, secures the approvals and completes the office fit out through to handover. Whether you are moving into a new office or renovating your current one, choose a package below by office size, compare finish levels and see what is included before you speak to us.

body: How much does office interior design cost in Dubai and Abu Dhabi?

Our office fit out projects start from 250 sqm, priced from AED 2,500 per sqm for a Budget finish, AED 3,500 per sqm for Executive and AED 6,000 per sqm for Premium, excluding VAT and loose furniture. The final figure depends on the building's condition (shell and core or Cat A), MEP changes, finishes and approvals. The package estimates above give a starting point, and we confirm pricing after a site visit.
How long does an office fit-out take?

Design and approvals usually take 4-9 weeks, and work on site around 8-10 weeks for a 250 sqm office and 16-22 weeks for a full floor. Free-zone and landlord approvals can add time, so we submit early and run design and permitting in parallel where possible.
What is the difference between Cat A and Cat B fit-out?

Cat A is the landlord's base finish: raised floors, ceilings, basic lighting and air conditioning. Cat B is everything that makes it your office: partitions, finishes, joinery, AV, branding and adapted MEP. Our packages are Cat B office fit outs, and if your space is shell and core we price the Cat A works separately. Loose furniture is not included.
Do you handle permits and approvals?

Yes. We prepare drawings and manage submissions to the landlord, municipality, Civil Defence, utilities and free-zone authorities where applicable, in both Dubai and Abu Dhabi. You receive the approvals and completion certificates at handover.
Can we see the design before work starts?
Yes. Every package includes 3D visuals, and executive and premium packages include full 3D of every zone. Premium projects also get a walkthrough video and a physical material sample board.
Can you work while our team is still in the office?
Yes. For refurbishments we phase the work, isolate site zones and schedule noisy or dusty tasks after hours and on weekends, subject to building rules.

No. Loose furniture such as desks, chairs and sofas is not part of our scope. We plan the layout around the furniture you buy or already own, provide the sizes and power positions your supplier needs, and coordinate delivery with the site programme. Reusing existing furniture is one of the easiest ways to keep the budget down.
What does design and build include?

Everything from the first layout to the keys. We handle the space plan, the office interior design, the approvals and the full office fit out, so you have one team and one point of responsibility from start to finish.
Why are you considered among the best interior design companies in Dubai and Abu Dhabi?

Clients choose us for 17+ years of office work in the UAE, 500+ completed projects, ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001 certification, and offices in both Dubai Media City and Abu Dhabi. Every project is designed and built by the same team, which keeps budgets and timelines under control.
Do you work in free zones?
Yes, including offices in Dubai Media City, Internet City, DIFC, DMCC, JAFZA and Abu Dhabi's free zones. Each has its own fit-out guidelines, which we follow from the first layout.

We complete snagging, hand over as-built drawings and operation manuals, and remain responsible for defects during the liability period set out in your contract. Maintenance support is available after that.
